title: ui-main: compose ProgressiveDiscover component
description: Compose the main ProgressiveDiscover component that orchestrates the entire Progressive Discover workflow. Integrates all phase components (Extracting, Preview, KirkCompilation, Locked) with the state machine hook to create a seamless user experience.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the appropriate phase component based on current state
THE SYSTEM SHALL coordinate all phase components through shared state

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL initialize state machine and render current phase
THE SYSTEM SHALL unmount current phase and mount next phase with animation

unwanted.condition: IF state machine fails to initialize
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render broken UI

unwanted.condition: IF phase component fails to render
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT crash entire workflow

preconditions: All phase components must be implemented
State machine hook must be available
Phase routing logic must be defined
postconditions: ProgressiveDiscover displays correct phase for current state
Phase transitions are smooth and animated
invariants: Exactly one phase is rendered at a time
State machine is single source of truth

happy: Given ProgressiveDiscover mounts, when state is extracting, then ExtractingPhase is rendered
Given state transitions to preview, when transition occurs, then PreviewPhase is rendered with animation
Given workflow completes, when locked phase is active, then LockedPhase shows completion summary
error: Given unknown phase state, when component renders, then fallback to extracting phase
Given state machine error, when error occurs, then error boundary displays recovery options
Given phase component crash, when crash occurs, then error boundary catches and shows error UI
